notes.claim: Transposing engineering formulae is listed as a skill learners are advised to have on entry to the SQA HN Engineering Mathematics 1 unit.
Solving a linear equation and changing the subject of a formula use the same process, according to BBC Bitesize.

sources.title: Module 6 (M6) – Algebra - Changing the subject of the formula - BBC Bitesize
sources.quote: The process of solving a linear equation and the process of changing the subject are exactly the same.

sources.title: national unit specification: general information
sources.quote: it would be advantageous if learners had good algebraic skills together with an ability to transpose engineering formulae and solve simple trigonometric equations.
